notes:
V3.0.0 — Wave 1 of the social layer.

• NEW: Friends system. Add the FRIENDS corner button (between MAKE BOT and TOOLS) to search for other APEX users by username, send / accept / decline friend requests, and view what they've chosen to share with you.

• NEW: Sharing controls. Privacy-first: every toggle defaults to OFF. Per-stat columns for FRIENDS vs EVERYONE — share your broker (Alpaca / IBKR), daily / monthly / yearly P/L, and bot library names independently. 'Discoverable' must be on for others to find you in user search.

• NEW: Server endpoints — GET /friends, POST /friends/request, POST /friends/{id}/respond, DELETE /friends/{id}, GET /friends/search, GET / PUT /share-settings, GET /users/{username}/profile. All bearer-auth. The /profile endpoint redacts fields the viewer isn't allowed to see based on the target's settings + friendship status, and aggregates per-period P&L from the target's linked Alpaca accounts when permitted.

• Foundation for the rest of V3 (bot market revamp, credits, admin hierarchy, themes) — those land in subsequent waves.
